answer: One defence is Assigned school inspector permit with school inspectors attestation: a permit inspectors renew after visit audits, and the saffron of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the gale is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the pulse of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
